remarks: Over 23 acres of partially wooded, partially cleared land on the corner of Chestnut St. and Beebe Rd. The possibilities are endless for this nature lover's paradise. You can build your dream home and hunt in your own back yard (tower stand and some tree stands will stay) OR just watch the wildlife play! 985 feet of road frontage on Chestnut Street and 1005 feet of road frontage on Beebe Rd. There is a driveway on Chestnut and access to the field on Beebe. There are some woods, cable, electric, gas and water at the lot....there is even a fire hydrant on the property (to help with those pesky insurance premiums)!  There is a hand dug well on the Beebe side of the property, be careful when walking the land with your real estate agent. Part of the land is farmed; the farmer has the right to harvest his pumpkins in the fall (he's a nice fella).
